title: One-Step Prediction Fidelity Is a Poor Proxy for Planning Performance in JEPA World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models are routinely selected, checkpointed and ablated on one-step prediction loss, on the assumption that a model which predicts the next latent better is a better model. In model-based RL this assumption is known to be unreliable; we ask whether it also fails for latent world models, where the training target is the model's own embedding and the loss is not expressed in interpretable units. We introduce a frozen-decoder protocol reporting one-step error in physical units, decomposed into the part already present in the encoder's representation and the part the predictor adds. Applying it to a recent end-to-end JEPA world model across three continuous-control environments, we move the metric by fine-tuning and measure goal-conditioned planning on the same checkpoints, with three training seeds and paired planning seeds throughout. translated_title: 单步预测保真度是JEPA世界模型规划性能的糟糕代理指标
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型通常基于单步预测损失进行选择、检查点保存和消融实验，其背后的假设是：能更好地预测下一个潜在表示的模型就是更好的模型。在基于模型的强化学习中，这一假设已被证明并不可靠；我们追问它在潜在世界模型中是否同样失效——在潜在世界模型中，训练目标是模型自身的嵌入表示，且损失并不以可解释的单位来表达。我们提出一种冻结解码器协议，以物理单位报告单步误差，并将其分解为两部分：已存在于编码器表示中的误差部分，以及预测器所增加的误差部分。我们将该协议应用于一个近期的端到端JEPA世界模型，在三个连续控制环境中，通过微调移动该指标，并在相同的检查点上测量目标条件规划性能，全程使用三个训练种子和配对的规划种子。在单个环境内，按训练轮次的阶梯实验显示，这种相关性在单个……之后趋于饱和（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种以物理单位衡量单步误差并将其按来源分解的冻结解码器评估协议，通过实验证明在JEPA世界模型中，单步预测保真度并不能可靠预测目标条件规划性能，因此不应作为模型选择和检查点保存的代理指标。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a frozen-decoder protocol that measures one-step prediction error in physical units and decomposes it by source, demonstrating that one-step prediction fidelity is an unreliable proxy for goal-conditioned planning performance in JEPA world models.
